# Fee Simple

> Fee Simple, from Talos Operations LLC, pulls the owner of record and mailing address from North Carolina county tax cards and deeds, matched by parcel, for HOA collections.

## Site

- [Home](https://talosoperations.com/): What Fee Simple does and how to request early access.
- [Coverage](https://talosoperations.com/coverage.html): Which North Carolina counties Fee Simple covers today, live in production or surveyed with bulk data mapped.
- [Privacy Policy](https://talosoperations.com/privacy.html): What Fee Simple collects, what it does with it, who else handles it, and the choices you have.
- [Terms of Service](https://talosoperations.com/terms.html): The terms for using Fee Simple: your account, acceptable use, what the records are and are not, and our liability.

## Learn

- [Learn](https://talosoperations.com/learn/): An index of explanations of how North Carolina property records work.
- [How to find out who owns a property in NC from county records](https://talosoperations.com/learn/nc-property-owner-lookup/): How to find a North Carolina property owner from the county tax card and the recorded deed.
- [Deed vs. tax card: what each record is](https://talosoperations.com/learn/deed-vs-tax-card/): What the recorded deed and the county tax card each are, and how to check one against the other.
- [Grantor vs. grantee: reading a deed index](https://talosoperations.com/learn/grantor-vs-grantee/): What grantor and grantee mean, and how a Register of Deeds index is organized and searched.
- [What is a chain of title, and how is one checked in NC?](https://talosoperations.com/learn/chain-of-title-nc/): How a chain of title is followed through the NC grantor/grantee index, and what a break looks like.
- [Finding the owner behind an LLC-owned property in NC](https://talosoperations.com/learn/llc-property-owner-nc/): How the NC Secretary of State's business registry is used to find who is behind an LLC-owned parcel.
